description: Build the server: APIs, data, auth, and background jobs

interface.shortDescription: Build the server: APIs, data, auth, and background jobs
interface.longDescription: Implement the production server behind the contract — API endpoints, domain logic, OLTP persistence, auth, async jobs and messaging, caching, security controls, integrations, and the tests that prove it runs — across REST, GraphQL, gRPC, realtime, serverless/edge, and agentic systems in Node, Python, Go, Rust, or the JVM. A faceted router: pick one engineering job and at most one runtime surface (agentic stacks additively), retrieval-first and default-stack-then-deviate. Implements inside architecture's decisions; hands running services to operate and its tests to quality.
defaultPrompt: Use $backend to implement the server behind this contract: endpoints, persistence, auth, and the tests that prove it works.
